stories.title: Paramount faz acordo em ação judicial movida por Estados e abre caminho para compra da Warner

en.title: Paramount settles lawsuit with states, clearing path for Warner acquisition
en.summary: Paramount has reached a settlement agreement in legal action filed by states, facilitating its merger with Warner.

stories.title: Paramount fecha acordo com 12 estados dos EUA que abre caminho para fusão de US$ 110 bilhões com a Warner

en.title: Paramount reaches agreement with 12 US states paving way for $110 billion Warner merger
en.summary: Paramount and 12 US states have agreed to settle disputes, enabling the $110 billion merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.

stories.title: Debate com candidatos ao Senado pelo RJ

en.title: Debate with Senate candidates for Rio de Janeiro
en.summary: Rio de Janeiro will hold two Senate candidate debates on Tuesday with eight participants divided into two groups, broadcast live across multiple platforms.

stories.title: Grandes emissoras de TV dos EUA suspendem cobertura conjunta de Trump em apoio à CNN

en.title: Major US TV broadcasters suspend joint Trump coverage in support of CNN
en.summary: Large American television networks have halted combined coverage of Trump in solidarity with CNN.

stories.title: Ministério da Justiça demite Eduardo Bolsonaro por abandono de cargo

en.title: Ministry of Justice dismisses Eduardo Bolsonaro for job abandonment
en.summary: Brazil's Justice Ministry dismissed former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro from his position as Federal Police clerk due to abandonment of post, citing unjustified absences exceeding 30 consecutive days.

stories.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro, nos EUA desde 2025, é demitido da PF por abandono de cargo

en.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro, in the US since 2025, is dismissed from Federal Police for job abandonment
en.summary: Brazil's Justice Minister dismissed former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro from his position as Federal Police clerk due to abandonment of post. Bolsonaro has resided in the United States since 2025.

stories.title: Paramount e procurador da Califórnia negociam para viabilizar compra da Warner por US$ 110 bi

en.title: Paramount and California attorney general negotiate to enable Warner purchase for US$ 110 billion
en.summary: Paramount and California's attorney general are in advanced negotiations over concessions for a potential deal, including a proposed 1.5 billion dollar investment in productions within the state.

stories.title: Dólar cai e Bolsa sobe com petróleo em baixa e cenário eleitoral no radar

en.title: Dollar falls and stock market rises with lower oil and electoral scenario in focus
en.summary: Brazil's currency weakened while the stock market gained on Monday, driven by declining international oil prices and the domestic electoral outlook.

stories.title: Quem é Presley Gerber, filho de Cindy Crawford morto aos 27 anos

en.title: Who is Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford who died at 27
en.summary: Presley Gerber, son of supermodel Cindy Crawford, died at age 27 at a rehabilitation clinic. The cause of death has not been disclosed.

stories.title: Impeachment de ministros do STF une candidatos da esquerda à direita na disputa pelo Senado em SP

en.title: Impeachment of Supreme Court ministers unites left and right candidates in Senate race in São Paulo
en.summary: The issue of impeachment for Supreme Court ministers has become a unifying topic among political candidates across the left-right spectrum competing for Senate seats in São Paulo.

stories.title: Ibovespa sobe com Boletim Focus, petróleo em baixa e pesquisas eleitorais em foco

en.title: Ibovespa rises with Focus Bulletin, oil down and electoral polls in focus
en.summary: The Brazilian stock index Ibovespa gained ground as investors monitored the Focus Bulletin, declining oil prices, and electoral survey data.

stories.title: Principais emissoras de TV dos EUA suspendem cobertura conjunta de Trump em apoio à CNN

en.title: Major U.S. TV networks suspend joint coverage of Trump in support of CNN
en.summary: Major U.S. television networks announced the suspension of joint coverage of President Donald Trump's activities in solidarity with CNN, which the White House had blocked along with other outlets.

stories.title: China avança em acordo para compra de aviões da Boeing

en.title: China advances in agreement to purchase Boeing aircraft
en.summary: China is progressing toward fulfilling a commitment to buy 200 Boeing jets announced in May, according to the U.S. Trade Representative. Approximately 140 orders are at an advanced stage, with 10 others being formalized.

stories.title: China desacelera IPOs de robôs humanoides à medida que entusiasmo supera realidade

en.title: China slows humanoid robot IPOs as enthusiasm outpaces reality
en.summary: Chinese regulators are restraining companies seeking to go public in the humanoid robotics sector while assessing whether valuations reflect genuine commercial demand. The slowdown follows volatile trading in Unitree Robotics shares, which surged five times at debut but fell 55% from peak.

stories.title: Presidente da CVM apelidou Vorcaro de 'leãozinho da montanha', mostram mensagens obtidas pela PF

en.title: CVM president nicknamed Vorcaro 'mountain lion' in messages obtained by Federal Police
en.summary: Messages found by federal authorities show ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro supported Otto Lobo's appointment as CVM president, and Lobo allegedly called Vorcaro a diminutive nickname in conversations. Lobo denies having knowledge of or influence over third-party private conversations.

stories.title: Governo vai anunciar contingenciamento do Orçamento nesta semana

en.title: Government to announce budget contingency measures this week
en.summary: Brazil's economic team plans to announce budget resource contingency measures in the bimonthly revenue and expenditure assessment report to be released Thursday.

stories.title: Do cartão corporativo aos serviços de gerenciamento financeiro: como a Visa virou a chave para o B2B

en.title: From corporate cards to financial management services: how Visa turned the key for B2B
en.summary: Visa has expanded beyond its traditional consumer payment card business to offer a broader range of financial solutions targeting the B2B market, addressing challenges faced by companies in managing their transactions and finances.
